000.$description: Used by: light bg.page (Sampled), light bg.sheet (Sampled), light surface.menu (Sampled).

red.$description: YouTube red: the watch-progress bar under a thumbnail (#FE0A34 in dark, #FF0034 in light, two pixel rows) and the dot on the Subscriptions tab (#E1012E). The same in both themes. It marks the brand and progress, never an error or a button.

chip.$description: Filter chips: 8.5pt in both themes, on a 32 pt chip. Plus or minus 2 pt.

thumbnail.$description: Thumbnails in shelves and History (8.5pt) and Shorts cards (6.8pt). Feed thumbnails run edge to edge with no radius.

card.$description: The comments teaser card (11.9pt) and the top corners of a bottom sheet (11.9pt in both themes).

sheet.$description: Top corners of a bottom sheet (sort, My Ad Centre): the card radius.

menu.$description: The video overflow menu: 17.1pt. Plus or minus 2 pt.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the search field (15.4pt on 32 pt), ad buttons (17.1pt on 40 pt), View channel and Get Premium, the Subscribe pill, the comment field and the duration badge.

base.$description: Measured gaps land on multiples of 4 pt within a pixel or two.

xs.$description: Between a title and its meta line, and between a subscription avatar and its name.

sm.$description: Between chips in the filter row (about 8.5 pt, dark/13) and between a channel avatar and its title column.

md.$description: Screen margin of the feed: chips, channel avatars and the comments card start 12.5 pt from the screen edge.

lg.$description: Padding inside the comments card and between grouped blocks on the You tab.

xl.$description: Between shelves (Shorts, Most relevant, History, Library).

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of the feed, chips and cards. Settings lists sit further in, at about 18 pt (their icons start at x = 52 px).

accordionGap.$description: Gap between the outlined accordions in My Ad Centre: the first ends at 1160 px and the second starts at 1191 px down x = 60.

button.$description: Ad call-to-action and Watch buttons: 178x39.5pt, two side by side.

buttonLarge.$description: Full-width button on the Premium interstitial ('1 month free'): 319x55pt.

row.$description: Settings row (icon and one-line label), label to label.

rowSearch.$description: Search history and suggestion row, icon to icon.

accordion.$description: Outlined accordion row in My Ad Centre, outline included (edges 1067 to 1160 px down x = 60).

tabBar.$description: Tab bar: its top hairline sits 82 pt above the screen's bottom edge (rows.tabBar, y = 1600 of 1764 px); 48 pt of that holds the icons and labels, the rest is the home-indicator inset.

createButton.$description: Round Create (+) button in the middle of the tab bar.

avatarChannel.$description: Channel avatar beside a video title.

avatarProfile.$description: The owner's avatar on the You tab.

width.$description: Switch track: 36x18.5pt dark, 33x18pt light, anti-aliased edge excluded.

thumb.$description: Round switch thumb (19x19pt in dark), wider than the track is tall. The light thumb sits on a shadow and could not be bounded.

menuWidth.$description: Video overflow menu width: 265 pt dark, 261.5 pt light; nine items make it 463 pt tall in dark.

commentsCard.$description: Comments teaser on the watch page: 365x81pt.

touchTarget.$description: Rows, tab items and the header icons are 44 pt or more. Chips, the search field and View channel are 32 pt and sit in wider rows.

hairline.$description: The tab bar's top line, two device pixels (border.tabBar).

outline.$description: Outlined buttons (Get Premium) and accordions: a two-pixel line at 2x (border.outline, border.accordion).

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. Body text looks like Roboto and headings like a heavier display face (the nav titles, 'Shorts', the Premium headline); neither can be proved from a screenshot, so use the platform font.

regular.$description: Settings rows, menu items, search rows, meta lines, helper text. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Video titles, chip labels, button labels. Judged by stroke width.

bold.$description: Nav titles, shelf and section titles, the Premium headline. Judged by stroke width.

display.$description: The Premium interstitial headline, centred over two lines. Cap-height readings: 35pt.

sheetTitle.$description: Title of the My Ad Centre sheet. Cap-height readings: 25pt.

navTitle.$description: Nav bar title on pushed pages (Settings, General, Appearance). Cap-height readings: 22pt.

sectionTitle.$description: Shelf and section titles: History, Library, Most relevant, the Settings 'Account' header. Cap-height readings: 18pt.

body.$description: Settings rows and overflow-menu items. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

videoTitle.$description: Video titles under feed cards and on the watch page, up to two lines. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

label.$description: Button and chip labels (Watch, Install, Today). Cap-height readings: 14pt.

meta.$description: Meta lines (channel, views, age), helper text, suggestion second lines, channel names under avatars, the Subscribe label. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

tab.$description: Tab bar labels (Home, Shorts, Subscriptions, You). Cap-height readings: 9pt.

notTokenised: Ambient tint: the block under a video or an ad takes a dark tint from its artwork in dark (surface.adCard reads #020F1B under one ad and a dark red under another); only the readings are kept
Tab bar material: the bar is translucent over the feed, so its fill is a reading of one moment
Shadows: the light overflow menu and switch thumb cast soft shadows; none was measured
Line heights of one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured

page.$description: Every page: home, Shorts shelf, You, search, settings.

scrim.$description: Black at 50%: the You tab reads #FFFFFF undimmed and #7F7F7F under the sort sheet.

secondary.$description: Unselected filter chips, the search field, the library chips: the app's one raised neutral.

inverse.$description: The selected chip, filled buttons and the View channel pill: the theme's ink, white in dark and near-black in light.

menu.$description: The video overflow menu (white with a soft shadow in light).

tabBar.$description: Tab bar, a translucent material over the feed; a reading of one moment.

createButton.$description: The round Create (+) button in the tab bar. The box's dominant colour covers 40% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

card.$description: The comments teaser card on the watch page (a reading over the page's ambient tint). Not captured in light: filled from surface.secondary, the closest light role.

field.$description: The 'Comment...' field inside the comments card. Not captured in light: filled from surface.secondary.

ad.$description: Block behind an ad's text and buttons. In dark it takes a tint from the ad's artwork (this one is navy), so treat it as a reading, not a fixed colour.

adSheet.$description: Body of the My Ad Centre sheet. Not captured in light: the sheet's body stays dark in the light theme too (light/03), so the dark value is the light value.

tabBar.$description: Hairline along the top of the tab bar. The box's dominant colour covers 36% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

accordion.$description: Outline of the accordions and the Send feedback button in My Ad Centre. Not captured in light: the sheet body is dark in both themes.

primary.$description: Video titles, settings rows, menu items, search rows, chip labels.

secondary.$description: Meta lines (channel, views, age), helper text, row values, suggestion second lines, the owner's handle. Readings in this role: #61615F, #616161, #626262, #666666, #676767.

placeholder.$description: 'Search YouTube' in the empty search field.

inverse.$description: Labels on the inverse surface: the selected chip, filled buttons, View channel.

link.$description: Text links ('All' at the end of the subscriptions row).

linkOnSheet.$description: Link inside the My Ad Centre sheet (Safety Centre), lighter than text.link. Not captured in light: the sheet body is dark in both themes.

default.$description: The app's blue: the new-content dot on a subscription avatar, text links, the switch thumb when on. The box's dominant colour covers 64% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

red.$description: YouTube red: watch progress and the Subscriptions tab dot. The same in both themes.

caret.$description: Text caret in the focused search field: the only focus indicator seen. A reading of two pixel columns; the light caret may have been mid-blink. The box's dominant colour covers 40% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

bg.$description: Primary call to action (Install, Shop now, Learn more): the theme's ink.
The secondary button beside it (Watch). In dark it takes the ad's tint (navy here); in light it reads a neutral grey.
View channel: the inverse surface as a pill.
Get Premium: the page colour with an outline.
Subscribe pill on a Short, white over the video. Not captured in light: it sits on video or artwork, so the dark value is used.
The '1 month free' button on the Premium interstitial, dark over a light gradient. Not captured in light: the interstitial was seen once, in dark; it draws its own light background.

onTrack.$description: Switch on, track: a pale blue.

onThumb.$description: Switch on, thumb: the accent blue.

duration.$description: Black at 60% under a thumbnail's duration, read where the badge sits on a white frame (#FFFFFF beside it, #666666 under it). The same in both themes: it sits on artwork.

check.$description: Tick on the chosen row of a choice list (Appearance, library sort).

grabber.$description: Grabber at the top of a bottom sheet. The box's dominant colour covers 50% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

info.$description: Info: the accent blue (new content). No success, warning or danger colour appeared.

notTokenised: Success, warning and danger colours: no such state was seen; YouTube red marks the brand and progress, not errors
Pressed and disabled states: stills only, and no disabled control appeared
Ambient tints under videos and ads: they follow the artwork
